name: PowerKit Addons For Elementor
author: Webhook Academy

sections.description:
PowerKit Addons for Elementor offers a rich collection of unique widgets, templates, and ready-made sections to take your Elementor designs to the next level.With our professionally crafted templates, you can create stunning,
https://www.youtube.com/@WebhookAcademy
fully responsive web pages in minutes — all without writing a single line of code. Built to be lightweight and seamlessly integrated with Elementor, PowerKit Addons ensures smooth performance while giving you the creative freedom to design faster and smarter.

Useful Links

  • 📂 GitHub Repository: https://github.com/webhookacademy/powerkit-addons-for-elementor
  • ▶️ YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@webhookacademy

Key Features

Unique Elementor Widgets – Add creative and functional elements that go beyond Elementor’s default offerings.

Pre-Designed Templates & Sections – Instantly import professionally crafted page templates and content sections.

Fully Responsive Designs – All widgets and templates are optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Lightweight & Fast Loading – Optimized code ensures your site stays fast without unnecessary bloat.

Seamless Elementor Integration – Works perfectly within the Elementor editor for a smooth workflow.

One-Click Import – Quickly insert templates or sections into any page with a single click.

Customizable Controls – Fine-tune styles, layouts, and animations without touching code.

Regular Updates – New widgets, templates, and enhancements are added to keep your site fresh.

Cross-Browser Compatibility – Looks great and functions perfectly across all major browsers.

Developer-Friendly – Clean, well-structured code following WordPress standards.

Installation Guide

Follow these steps to install Powerkit Addons For Elementor on your WordPress website:

  1. Download the Plugin:

    • Download the powerkit-addons-for-elementor.zip file.

  2. Upload the Plugin:

    • Log into your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
    • Click Upload Plugin and select the powerkit-addons-for-elementor.zip file.

  3. Activate the Plugin:

    • Once the installation is complete, click Activate to enable the plugin.

License

PowerKit Addons for Elementor is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No. PowerKit Addons for Elementor works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. However, if you have Elementor Pro, you can use our addons alongside Pro widgets and features without any conflict.

Why are some templates not importing?

If a template contains many images or large media files, it may take longer to import depending on your hosting speed and PHP settings. If the import fails, try:
1. Increasing your PHP memory limit and max execution time.
2. Importing again after clearing your browser cache.
3. Ensuring you are using the latest version of Elementor and this plugin.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. PowerKit Addons for Elementor is built to be lightweight and optimized for performance. All assets are loaded only when needed to avoid unnecessary bloat.

Can I use this plugin on client websites?

Yes. You can use PowerKit Addons on unlimited personal or client websites, as per the GPL license.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. This plugin works with any theme that supports Elementor, including popular themes like Astra, OceanWP, and GeneratePress.

How often do you release new templates or widgets?

We regularly release updates with new widgets, templates, and features to keep your designs fresh and your workflow efficient.
